the initiation factors are not only involved in the initiation process, but also play a role in the control of the ribosome structure and function.

The main takeaway from our work is that

IF-3 and to a smaller extent IF-1 are responsible for the dissociation of the Escherichia colibacterial ribosome, while IF-2 promotes the association of ribosomal subunits, in agreement with the role of these factors in initiation of protein synthesis.
IF-1, IF-3 and GMPPCP or GDP all act on the equilibrium between the free and bound states of 70 S ribosomal particles, and that the effects of these factors are additive.
